findings.label: SecretValue.unsafePlainText for Google secret
findings.description: Using SecretValue.unsafePlainText(googleClientSecret) causes the SSM value to appear in the synthesized CloudFormation template. Not a runtime leak but the secret is visible in the template. Consider Secrets Manager with SecretValue.secretsManager() for cleaner pattern.

findings.label: Default behavior cache policy deviates from spec
findings.description: Design spec says patient origin should cache 1 day, but implementation uses CACHING_OPTIMIZED managed policy. The managed policy provides a 1-day default TTL anyway, so effectively compliant.
